reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that creative ability manifests as variance in how individuals utilize shared cognitive capacity. This variance stems from differences in perceptual lability—how easily one can shift between sign-gestalts. The formalism treats this as a dynamical system where each organism's means-end readiness evolves over time, subject to both fixed ultimate capacity and variable initial constraints. The key operator is the creative ability variance C_A, defined as the difference in convergence speed toward new readiness states given identical starting conditions. Perceptual lability L_p modulates this process by determining how quickly perception and memory can be reorganized. Sign-gestalt emergence G(t) represents the temporal trajectory of cognitive restructuring driven by engagement with particulars. These primitives form a unified framework where creative performance is modeled as a stochastic optimization over a space of possible sign-gestalt configurations, constrained by individual capacity and influenced by perceptual instability.
